subspans.definition: B-05's taxonomy, unchanged (B-05 PREREG.json 'subspans' at a91a86a4a; harness/b05/b05_spans.py byte-identical). Each in-T call is split at every Driver mark and caller stamp; each interval is labelled by its left point; per-mark correction subtracts c_m from every interval that starts at a Driver mark.

groups.transport_in_out: c_in.* + pipe_in/pipe_out + d_in.* + d_out.* + c_out.* except c_out.validate

subspans.R2_10_mapping: R2-10R's own analysis (harness/r2-10r/analyze_r2_10.py, b01_analysis, analyze_browser) on the trace with the B-05-new marks removed (R's mark set)

phase0_source_map.class: SOURCE (R' tree 45dff8f32 + picks; jev-use venv mcp 1.30.0)

code: mcp/shared/session.py BaseSession.send_request: id, response stream, request.model_dump(by_alias, mode=json, exclude_none), JSONRPCRequest(**data), JSONRPCMessage, SessionMessage, write_stream.send (capacity-0 memory stream: hand-off to the stdin-writer task)
mcp/client/stdio stdout_reader: SessionMessage(message), read_stream_writer.send (capacity-0 hand-off to the session receive loop)
send_request wakes from response_stream_reader.receive() and calls result_type.model_validate (c.result_model_start)

d_out.post.interval: dispatch.exit, (<tool>, dispatch_exit|invoke_end), rt.*, sdk.*, mcp.invoke_end, mcp.conformed, mcp.handled, (mcp:*, handler_end) -> mcp.serialize_start
code: cua-driver/src/sdk_adapter.rs: raw_json parse, session mirror (sdk.call_end -> sdk.parsed)

cua-driver-core/src/mcp_result.rs conforming_tool_result: validate_wire_output (per-tool-name lazily compiled jsonschema validator in OUTPUT_VALIDATORS) + validate_success_output (typed ActionResult check)
cua-driver/src/proxy.rs run_direct: mcp.handled -> handler_end -> timer.finish, context.complete, observe_proxy_tool_completed -> mcp.serialize_start
d_out.post.design_input: B-05 A1 raw (binary B5, design input only, not a B-07 result): every d_out.post interval is 33-57 us per mark (about c_m = 34.5 us) except mcp.invoke_end -> mcp.conformed on the FIRST call of each action-result tool in a process (fill browser_type 276 us, browser_click 306 us; toggle/modal first browser_click 267/307 us) against 48-51 us on the second call: the lazy per-tool-name compile of the shared ActionResult output validator, once per fresh Driver process

adm.inner.interval: mcp.admitted, identity_applied, session_begun, timer_started, (mcp:*, handler_start), inner_classified, inner_tools_list_built, inner_validation_skipped -> mcp.inner_validated
code: cua-driver/src/proxy.rs run_direct: apply_direct_session_identity (writes _session_id / _transport_session_id), sdk.begin_tool_call (session observation context), tool_observation_timer
cua-driver-core/src/server.rs handle_request_with_transport_session_prevalidated: inner classification; the B-02 cached path already skips the repeated inner validation (inner_validation_skipped)
adm.inner.design_input: B-05 A1 raw: per-mark intervals 33-77 us (c_m + 0-43 us); the only intervals clearly above c_m are identity_applied (+20-34 us) and session_begun (+4-43 us)
adm.inner.removed_from_menu: No byte-preserving deletion exists that keeps the invariants. The work above c_m is (1) applying the transport-minted session identity to the arguments, which is how the Driver binds the call to its session (logical routine identity may persist, but session epochs/identity are applied per call, never cached as authority), and (2) opening the per-call session observation context that completion accounting closes after the call. The rest of adm.inner is mark cost and an already-deleted repeat validation (B-02). Verdict rule for adm.inner in admission_rule below.

PREP_FAST.kind: measured caller change (harness only; jev-use client stack, mcp 1.30.0)
PREP_FAST.implementation: harness/b07_stdio.py _call_tool: for a plain-JSON tools/call (arguments of str / bool / int within +-2**53 / list / dict only; no meta, progress callback or read timeout) build the JSON-RPC line directly ('{"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":...,"arguments":...},"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":N}') and write it to the Driver's stdin from the calling task; same id allocation, response stream, result model and output validation as the library. Anything else: library path
PREP_FAST.equivalence: byte-identical request lines: every tools/call request line of every Phase B trial in both arms equals the library serialisation of the same (name, arguments, id) (harness/b07_equivalence.py); FIXTURE edge cases (harness/b07_controls.py prep_bytes) identical between arms and to the library, fallback types take the library path

ROUTE_FAST.implementation: harness/b07_stdio.py stdout_reader: a parsed JSONRPCResponse/JSONRPCError with an int id that has a pending waiter, on a session without response routers, is sent with send_nowait to that waiter's response stream (the object the receive loop would have sent); anything else, or any failure, takes the library path
ROUTE_FAST.equivalence: decoded-identical responses: the canonical JSON of every result object handed to CallToolResult.model_validate equals that of the corresponding tools/call response line, in order, in both arms (harness/b07_equivalence.py); identical validation verdicts (same compiled validators on identical objects); malformed-frame negative control (harness/b07_controls.py malformed): identical outcome per frame in both arms and every malformed frame rejected

POST_FAST.implementation: CUA_DRIVER_EXP_OUTPUT_VALIDATOR_PREWARM=1: the direct stdio transport compiles the shared ActionResult output validator once before the first request and enters it for every action-result tool name; unset = lazy per-tool compile as shipped
POST_FAST.equivalence: byte-identical responses: every response line of every Phase B trial compared between arms after removing per-trial values is not possible (refs/tokens differ per trial), so: (a) UNIT b07_prewarm_shares_one_validator_and_keeps_results_identical (identical result bytes before/after for a valid and a schema-rejected payload on three tools); (b) per trial, the tools/call response lines' JSON key structure and the validation outcome are identical between arms (harness/b07_equivalence.py shape check); (c) N4a refusals identical
POST_FAST.work_note: the compile moves to transport start (outside T); per process the action-result tools share one compile instead of one per tool name. Work deleted is reported for T (caller-observed Driver window) and the moved startup work is stated separately

selection_rule: After Phase A and before any Phase B trial, PREREG-AMENDMENT-1.json names the selected candidates. A candidate is selected iff its target sub-span has a Phase A corrected (per-mark c_m) per-task mean >= 0.5 ms in at least one class. Fixed here; the amendment only applies it.

phase_A.design: 32 rounds, class order rotated per round (harness/b07_browser.py plan A), COMP marks on, 96 measured trials (32 per class)
phase_A.c_m: median of the in-situ null-pair intervals (b05_spans.NULL_PAIRS) over Phase A
phase_A.coverage_gate: B-05 sub-span coverage of T_runner (1 - other/T_runner) >= 0.98 on every valid trial; a trial below it is kept, reported and excluded from attribution means
phase_A.outputs: R'-source decomposition per class: every sub-span raw and corrected (mean, 95% CI, median), groups transport_in_out / admission_residual / resolution / client_validation, R2-10 component view (consistency with R2-10R's own code checked per trial)

overhead_control.design: 20 AB/BA rounds per class, COMP vs COMP_OFF (plan ovh)
overhead_control.report: paired T_runner and T_oracle penalty of marks on, per class, mean and 95% CI; predicted penalty marks x c_m; their ratio; corrected view at c_m and at the measured scale x_pooled (pooled measured/predicted) as sensitivity

phase_B.design: per selected candidate: 30 AB/BA rounds per class, COMP_OFF vs candidate (plan B); N4a 5 per class in COMP_OFF and in each candidate arm (15 per arm)
phase_B.primary_metric: T_oracle (R2-10 rule: from task start to the first 2 ms independent-oracle sample at/after the last accepted mutation's return showing the expected final state), paired saving = COMP_OFF - candidate
phase_B.secondary: T_runner paired; work deleted per task from caller stamps (marks off): PREP_FAST sum of call_send -> c.req_written; ROUTE_FAST sum of c.parsed -> c.result_model_start; POST_FAST sum of the caller-observed Driver window c.req_written -> c.first_byte over the in-T calls
phase_B.gate: per candidate and class: DELETED iff mean T_oracle saving >= 0.5 ms AND its 95% CI excludes 0 (lower > 0) AND validity 100% AND equivalence 100% AND N4a 15/15 refused (effect=refused, then one rebind, verified) in both arms AND negative control passes AND no T_runner regression (CI upper < 0). DELETED -> KEEP as a default-off knob (POST_FAST) or a measured caller change (PREP_FAST/ROUTE_FAST). Otherwise KILL, and the target sub-span maps to IRREDUCIBLE for E2, or BELOW_GATE where its Phase A corrected mean is < 0.5 ms in that class

unselected_rule: a candidate not selected: its target sub-span is BELOW_GATE in a class where the Phase A corrected CI upper is < 0.5 ms; otherwise UNTESTED (not selected)
admission_rule: adm.inner (removed from the menu): per class, BELOW_GATE if its Phase A corrected CI upper < 0.5 ms, else IRREDUCIBLE (invariant: session identity and session observation context, phase0_source_map.adm.inner.removed_from_menu)
other_subspans: B-05's terminal verdicts carry over as labels: c_out.parse and c_out.validate IRREDUCIBLE (candidate failed), res.frame_proof / res.type_focus / res.cdp_node_resolve / res.editable_check IRREDUCIBLE (invariant). Every other B-05 sub-span is re-evaluated on R' Phase A: BELOW_GATE if its corrected CI upper < 0.5 ms, else UNTESTED (no candidate)

modal_stall.definition: a caller stall is any single interval > 20 ms inside T between consecutive caller-side points of one call that the B-05 labels give to a c_in.* or c_out.* sub-span
modal_stall.report: per class: c_in.prep (and T_oracle) with all valid Phase A trials and with the trials that contain a caller stall excluded
modal_stall.classification: descriptive only: GC if a recorded gc start/stop pair (b07_stdio gc callback) overlaps >= 50% of the stall; otherwise scheduler/other, with the trial's 1-minute loadavg

e2_output.share: R'-source untested share of mean T_runner (corrected at c_m and raw) per class, BELOW_GATE counted as IRREDUCIBLE and as UNTESTED. Components outside the lane keep R2-10R's verdicts (analyze_r2_10.BROWSER_VERDICTS); lane sub-spans take the verdicts above
e2_output.cold_excess: two separate mappings, never combined with each other or with B-06 numbers: (a) R2-10's carry-over mapping (observation IRREDUCIBLE); (b) B-04: E = span(snapshot1) - span(snapshot2) on B7 Phase A (harness/b04/b04_rows.py snap_measures, byte-identical from 8620ebfa2); per-document part IRREDUCIBLE but unsized, per-process part pending B-06, so u = 1 and the whole E counts as UNTESTED for fill and toggle (modal unchanged, as in B-04)
e2_output.never: no number is added to or ratioed with another binary's (B5, R, R', B7)

load: a round starts only at 1-minute loadavg <= 4.0; otherwise the harness waits up to 60 s (2 s polls) and then ends the chunk; the next chunk resumes at that round. Every gate attempt is in the run manifest. Loadavg is recorded per trial and every trial is kept
locks: every measured chunk: cargo-build lock first, then bin/quiet-timed <label> (EXCLUSIVE quiet-lane lock, receipt in the shared ledger), then cua-x11-session.sh; <= 10 min per acquisition (harness --max-minutes 9, timeout 600 s)
oracle: independent, target-owned jev-use fixture-server state sampled every 2 ms by a harness thread (R2-10 Sampler); a trial is verified only with the expected final state and exactly one completion mutation in the fixture journal
e4: per arm: 0 stale-ref dispatches, 0 duplicate mutations, 0 unverified successes, 0 refusals returned as success (R2-10R e4_totals)
statistics: seeded bootstrap (seed 20261003, 10000 resamples) of the mean; paired by (class, round); every trial kept; invalid trials stay in the denominator of validity
order_of_work: default-off smoke B7 vs R' (5 per class each, BASE, no CUA_DRIVER_EXP_*, no trace)
claim_boundary: one host, private Xvfb, system Chrome (version read in session), binary B7 only for Part 1 (R' 922111c5 only for the default-off smoke), scripted chooser, no provider; knobs env-gated and default-off; no new service
